bodies.name: Board of Trustees of Eagle Mountain-Saginaw ISD

answer.rationale: The official agenda and recording player explicitly name both the Eagle Mountain-Saginaw ISD Board of Trustees and the Fort Worth City Council as the meeting bodies. The agenda documents a convened meeting with call to order, district and city reports, separate board president and mayor announcements, and adjournment; the recording chapters corroborate that structure. Assign the whole joint recording to the configured EMSISD Board joint-meetings feed and the Council feeds, including the general Fort Worth feed whose description covers City Council recordings. The joint-meetings feed is a subscription grouping, not a separate convening institution. The opening ceremony and embedded presentation/video do not turn this full joint meeting into an excluded ceremony or an archive-only film.
